request.query: infinite set remove finite subset injective image remains infinite

content.text:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "formal_name": "Set.Infinite.diff",
      "informal_name": "Infinite Set Minus Finite Set is Infinite",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u} {s t : Set α}, s.Infinite → t.Finite → (s \\ t).Infinite",
      "informal_description": "If $ s $ is an infinite set and $ t $ is a finite set, then the set difference $ s \\setminus t $ is infinite.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Set.Finite.Basic"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Set.Infinite.exists_notMem_finset",
      "informal_name": "Existence of an Element in an Infinite Set Outside a Finite Subset",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u} {s : Set α}, s.Infinite → ∀ (t : Finset α), ∃ a ∈ s, a ∉ t",
      "informal_description": "Let $ s $ be an infinite set of type $ \\alpha $. Then, for every finite subset $ t $ of $ \\alpha $, there exists an element $ a \\in s $ such that $ a \\notin t $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Set.Finite.Basic"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Set.Infinite.exists_notMem_finite",
      "informal_name": "Infinite Set Contains Element Outside Finite Set",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u} {s t : Set α}, s.Infinite → t.Finite → ∃ a ∈ s, a ∉ t",
      "informal_description": "For any infinite set $ s $ and finite set $ t $, there exists an element $ a $ such that $ a \\in s $ and $ a \\notin t $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Set.Finite.Basic"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Cardinal.mk_compl_finset_of_infinite",
      "informal_name": "Cardinality of Complement of Finite Set in Infinite Set Equals Original",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u_1} [Infinite α] (s : Finset α), Cardinal.mk ↑(↑s)ᶜ = Cardinal.mk α",
      "informal_description": "For any infinite set $\\alpha$ and any finite subset $s$ of $\\alpha$, the cardinality of the complement of $s$ in $\\alpha$ is equal to the cardinality of $\\alpha$. That is, $|\\alpha \\setminus s| = |\\alpha|$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.SetTheory.Cardinal.Arithmetic"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Set.Finite.infinite_compl",
      "informal_name": "Complement of a Finite Set in an Infinite Type is Infinite",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u} [Infinite α] {s : Set α}, s.Finite → sᶜ.Infinite",
      "informal_description": "If $\\alpha$ is an infinite type and $s \\subseteq \\alpha$ is a finite set, then the complement of $s$ in $\\alpha$ is infinite.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Set.Finite.Basic"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Set.infinite_of_finite_compl",
      "informal_name": "Finite Complement Implies Infinite Set",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u} [Infinite α] {s : Set α}, sᶜ.Finite → s.Infinite",
      "informal_description": "Let $\\alpha$ be an infinite type. If the complement $s^c$ of a set $s \\subseteq \\alpha$ is finite, then $s$ is infinite.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Set.Finite.Basic"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Infinite.exists_notMem_finset",
      "informal_name": "Existence of Element Outside Finite Set in Infinite Type",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u_1} [Infinite α] (s : Finset α), ∃ x, x ∉ s",
      "informal_description": "For any infinite type $\\alpha$ and any finite subset $s$ of $\\alpha$, there exists an element $x \\in \\alpha$ such that $x \\notin s$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Fintype.EquivFin"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Set.Infinite.to_subtype",
      "informal_name": "Infinite Set's Subtype is Infinite",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u} {s : Set α}, s.Infinite → Infinite ↑s",
      "informal_description": "If a set $ s $ is infinite, then its corresponding subtype is also infinite.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Finite.Defs"
    }
  ]
}
